# InsideGrowth — Performance Marketing Agency

> InsideGrowth is a Romanian performance marketing agency specializing in Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, and conversion-focused website development. Founded by former Google and Meta specialists, we help local businesses, e-commerce brands, and growth-focused companies scale profitably through data-driven marketing systems.

## About InsideGrowth

InsideGrowth (operated by SELLMOTION S.R.L.) is based in Targu Mures, Romania. We are a team of 5 certified specialists with 20+ years of combined experience in digital marketing, paid media, SEO, web development, and creative production.

We manage €50K+ in monthly ad spend for clients across Romania and internationally. Our approach is systems-based — we combine traffic acquisition, conversion optimization, and tracking infrastructure so every part of the marketing ecosystem works together.

## Services

- **Google Ads** — Search, Shopping, Performance Max campaign management and scaling
- **Meta Ads** — Facebook and Instagram paid campaigns, audience targeting, retargeting
- **TikTok Ads** — Short-form video campaign management
- **SEO & Organic Growth** — Technical SEO, on-page optimization, keyword strategy, content optimization
- **Websites Built to Convert** — Custom presentation websites, e-commerce development, conversion-focused design
- **Creative Production** — Product photography, brand shoots, video production, ad creatives
- **Tracking & Performance Systems** — Google Tag Manager, GA4, conversion tracking, data reporting
- **Audit & Growth Analysis** — Full marketing ecosystem audit: website, tracking, ads, SEO

## Service Area

Romania (nationwide), with international growth capabilities for e-commerce brands.

## Target Clients

- Local businesses seeking qualified lead generation
- E-commerce brands wanting to scale ROAS and revenue
- Companies looking to lower cost per conversion
- Businesses ready for full-funnel paid media systems

## Pricing

- Growth Foundation: From €500/month (Google Ads management + SEO foundation + tracking)
- Growth & Scaling: From €800/month (+ Meta Ads + funnel optimization + creative testing)
- Performance Partner: €1,300+/month (+ TikTok Ads + daily optimization + growth strategy)
- Custom websites, photo/video production: project-based pricing
